Dodge Blocks

Dodge Blocks — steer your square past the falling blocks on canvas. Survive as long as you can.

0.0s
Time
0.0s
Best

←/→ or A/D to move · drag on touch

📖 How to use

  1. Press “Start”.
  2. Move left/right with arrow keys (or drag on touch).
  3. Dodge every falling block — one hit ends the run.
  4. Survive as long as possible for a high score.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I move?

Arrow keys or A/D to move (WASD works too). On touch screens, drag your finger across the game.

Does it get harder?

Blocks fall faster and spawn more often the longer you survive.

Is my best time saved?

Your longest survival time is saved in your browser.
